contexts.text: To compress her () = to be conjoined, but not in the lawful way of betrothal.
He who lay with a virgin was to give a dowry and marry her ().
What is purer and grosser may exist in the same degree, both according to extension and compression, and according to determinations.
In the external sense, straitness of spirit is a compression of the breast... That a state of compression of the breathing corresponds to anxiety on account of the deprivation of truth and good...

As the atmospheres decrease in their progression downwards, it follows that they continually become more compressed and inert, and at last in ultimates so compressed and inert that they are no longer atmospheres, but substances of rest...
The heart and lungs, where there are alternate expansions and compressions...
The expansions and compressions, or reciprocations (of the organic forms of the mind), are relative...
The women in Zion are ravished ().
